name: The Lakh MIDI Dataset (LMD)
description: The Lakh MIDI Dataset (LMD) is a collection of 176,581 unique MIDI files matched and aligned to metadata from the Million Song Dataset. Providing symbolic musical representations, score alignments, and instrument track annotations for music information retrieval and generative music modeling.
